environment.description: Kubernetes pod running on AmazonLinux 2023 node with default container runtime (runc). Pod security context: runAsUser 1000, no seccomp profile, no AppArmor annotation. Container has CAP_SYS_PTRACE retained. ALLOWED_BASE_DIR=/srv/data. Volume mounts include hostPath /srv/data (readWrite) and the container filesystem is writable. SELinux is in permissive mode on the host (setenforce 0 applied during node bootstrap for compatibility with legacy monitoring agents).
